messages:
Eli: anyone else seeing a spike in 5xx and p95 on /v1/generate in eu-west? looks like it started right after the 13:18 deploy
incident-bot: Paging on-call SRE_Rob (priority: P1) — incident created: config-routing-regression
SRE_Rob: on it. can you paste a few logs or a request id? need scope
Eli: pasted two sample req ids in thread. stack traces point to timeout in model routing service. error 504 from router -> heavy backend
Maya: seeing the same. Dedicated tenants EU* showing high error rate. Hosted looks mostly fine. spike in upstream latency to model variant gptx-long
oncall-junior: weird — last deploy included a configmap change for routing overrides. possible config drift?
EngOps: checking deploy history... last configmap update 13:17 by ci-bot in release/2025.1
SRE_Rob: can we dump the config? run: `kubectl -n redwood get configmap routing.override -o yaml`
Maya: output shows:
```
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
data:
  default_model: "gptx-short"
  override_for_eu: "gptx-long"
```
Maya: that override_for_eu should not have been in the release — it's a test toggle. it's routing a bunch of prod traffic to gptx-long which has much higher memory/latency
Eli: ohhh. that explains the timeouts. we need a fast kill for the flag or revert that single config commit
oncall-junior: propose toggling the feature flag first (safer than full rollback). `redwoodctl feature disable routing.override_eu` — will that short-circuit?
SRE_Rob: yep. do that and scale down the gptx-long pool as backup. I'll prepare a quick patch if flag flip doesn't take
deploy-bot: Received command: feature disable routing.override_eu
deploy-bot: Feature routing.override_eu disabled (actor: oncall-junior). Initiating routing refresh across eu cluster
Maya: seeing drop in error rate already, p95 starting to come down :thumbsup:
Eli: still seeing a small cohort with errors — looks like some pods cached the old config
SRE_Rob: ok let's push a one-line configmap revert. small patch, single commit. I'll do the apply and patch rollout.
SRE_Rob: patch (applied):
```
- override_for_eu: "gptx-long"
+ override_for_eu: ""
```
Commit: 7c9a2b1 — revert accidental routing override
deploy-bot: rollout started for configmap routing.override -> daemonset routing-propagator
deploy-bot: rollout complete: all eu nodes refreshed
QA-Alex: running quick synthetic checks against a handful of tenant keys — p50/p95/tps look back to baseline.:+1:
Maya: real traffic metrics show 5xx down from 6% -> 0.4% over the last 5m
Customer Success - Priya: compiling affected-tenant list. will draft a one-off postmortem note: summary + root cause + remediation + ETA for compensation if needed
Eli: quick ask — can we capture which deploy triggered the config change and add to postmortem? EngOps found ci-bot release/2025.1 but who merged the PR?
EngOps: PR #9127 merged by jamie at 13:16, auto-config injection added by the test harness. escalating to infra team to adjust CI permissions
SRE_Rob: creating incident ticket with timeline, links to logs and the revert commit. tagging infra and platform
SRE_Rob: handing off to night oncall Jamie for monitoring and post-incident followups — Jamie, take it
Jamie: on call. will keep an eye for 2h and own the customer comms thread with Priya. can you drop the incident runbook link? :spiral_notepad:
SRE_Rob: runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/config-routing-incident
QA-Alex: adding note to include improved sanity check in release pipeline for non-empty overrides to env-specific keys
Eli: thanks all — good catch on the config drift. follow-ups: CI perms, release gating for configmaps, and an automated test that validates routing overrides before deploy
Customer Success - Priya: draft ready, will send to legal for review then to affected customers within 90m
Jamie: I'll rotate out any oncoming pager recipients and follow up in morning triage. closing slack thread when handoff confirmed
Eli: +1 — closing timeline notes, will add the postmortem entry later. :white_check_mark:
